changelog:
Initial release of qq-hot-trend skill.

- Registers a QQ skill focused on extracting and summarizing information from publicly accessible QQ pages.
- Supports extraction of titles, authors, update times, summaries, and metadata from public bulletin, app, and group invite pages.
- Does not support login, messaging, or access to private/protected content.
- Automates content parsing only for public, shareable QQ links; follows platform security and access guidelines.
summary: Extract and summarize public QQ app pages, announcements, and group invites without login or message access.
